remarks: Top floor end unit in convenient downtown location. Walk to everything, restaurants, movies, shopping, etc. Extra windows because it is an end unit. Laundry on the first floor. 1 assigned parking spot close to back door, No. 22A . True 1 bedroom with lots of closets.  A new vanity was installed 2 years ago along with a new bathroom floor , new medicine cabinet and light fixture, as well as new shower fixtures. The bath tub was glazed white.  The kitchen cabinets were painted white with new stainless steel pulls. A new kitchen floor was put in as well as new counter tops 2 years ago. Heat and hot water included in the rent. Credit check and 2 months security plus 1 month's rent. Fabulous location!
